page.overview:
Who is Aika?

Aika grew up in Suki's village on Kyoshi Island during the late Hundred Year War. She experienced Team Avatar's visit and Zuko's raid on Kyoshi Island in 99 AG, helping to rebuild her home village afterward. When the leader of her Kyoshi Warrior team, Suki, asked her comrades whether they were willing to venture to the Earth Kingdom mainland to help others just as Avatar Aang did, Aika volunteered alongside Rie, Fume, and Mira.

After leaving their home per ship, one of the team's first destinations was Razor Reef in the southern Mo Ce Sea. There, the group sought a local martial arts master named Tidao, only to discover that the latter had long left the location. Yet they used the opportunity for a friendly sparring session with some local adventurers who were guarding an archaeologist, Wen, at Razor Reef. They then continued their journey to the mainland.

Once on the mainland, the group sought contacts to the Earth Kingdom Army. A fisherman claimed that they could find the military at Pebble Pond Village, offering to sell them ostrich horses as mounts for the journey. When he questioned the value of the group's Kyoshi Island money, Aika and Mira exchanged annoyed glances at his dismissive attitude. As Rie told him about their identity as Kyoshi Warriors, however, the fisherman was horrified due to hearing tales of the warriors' brutality, and gifted them the ostrich horses before running away. Unlike the rest of her comrades, Aika was unfazed by the man's reaction and instead more interested in a fish he had left behind.

Suki's group subsequently journeyed to Pebble Pond Village. On the way, Aika intensely prepared her weaponry, sharpening her sword so much that Suki commented on it. Aika countered that the Fire Nation had certainly improved their armor, feeling that they all had to prepare themselves for this.
